中心死区过滤回中偏移；0.12 表示摇杆中心 12% 不产生瞄准输出。若仍漂移可: The center deadzone filters resting offsets. A value of 0.12 disables aim within the central 12% of travel. Increase it gradually if drift remains; keep it below the Flick threshold. Aim speed rises continuously beyond the deadzone.
摇杆瞄准中心死区必须小于拨动转身阈值: The stick aim center deadzone must be below the Flick threshold
体感存在无法等价迁移的关键项，请核验摇杆瞄准／拨动设置: A required gyro setting could not be converted. Check the stick aiming or Flick configuration.
拨动选择朝向，沿摇杆外圈转动控制镜头。先在「校准」测量游戏转角，才能对应准确的朝: Flick to select a heading, then rotate around the rim to turn the camera. Measure the in-game angle under Calibration for accurate headings.
左右摇杆分别设置。摇杆鼠标、拨动／配套瞄准、方向映射和虚拟摇杆共用这里的输入处理: Set each stick independently. Stick mouse, Flick and companion aim, direction mappings and virtual sticks share this processing without adding separate deadzones.
姿态、边缘转向与拨动: Orientation, edge turning and Flick Stick
体感旋转与拨动／摇杆瞄准不能同时使用同一摇杆: Gyro rotation and Flick/stick aiming cannot use the same stick simultaneously
请在「体感」页启用体感，以使用拨动／转动和配套摇杆瞄准。: Enable motion on the Motion tab to use Flick Stick and paired stick aim.
拨动选择朝向，沿摇杆外圈转动控制镜头。在「游戏配置 → 体感 → 游戏内转角校准: Flick to face a direction and trace the outer edge to turn. Measure the game's turn angle under Game profile → Motion → In-game turn calibration to match the in-game angle.
摇杆鼠标、快速转向、方向映射和虚拟摇杆共用这里的输入死区。: Stick mouse, Flick Stick, direction mappings, and virtual sticks share these input deadzones.
曲线控制初始拨动的转角进度。完成时间设为 0 时立即输出全部转角。: The curve controls the initial turn's angle progress. A duration of 0 outputs the full angle immediately.
请先启用体感或拨动，再打开转角校准。: Enable gyro or Flick before opening turn calibration.
没转够 → 调小数值；转过头 → 调大数值。使用摇杆拨动前，请将游戏摇杆响应曲线: Too short → decrease the value. Too far → increase it. For stick Flick, set a linear in-game stick curve and disable edge and other turn acceleration.
使用摇杆拨动前，请将游戏摇杆响应曲线设为线性，并关闭边缘及其他转向加速。校准后保: For stick Flick, set a linear in-game stick curve and disable edge and other turn acceleration. Keep in-game sensitivity unchanged after calibration.
先校准游戏满杆角速度。若慢速移动被游戏忽略，可按游戏设置调整右摇杆内死区补偿和响: Calibrate the game's full-stick turn speed first. If the game ignores slow movements, match the right stick's inner deadzone compensation and response exponent to the game.
这三个参数只影响配套摇杆的连续瞄准，不改变快推拨动的目标转角。水平目标转速由基础: These three settings affect companion stick aiming only, not the target angle of a quick Flick. Horizontal target speed depends on the base rate, aim multiplier and stick progress; vertical speed also uses the vertical ratio.
按拨动转身阈值的比例计算，默认 50%。比例越高，转动时越要贴近外圈。100%: A percentage of the Flick turn threshold, defaulting to 50%. A higher ratio keeps tracking closer to the rim. At 100%, the two thresholds are equal.
摇杆持续低于追踪下限后，才允许下一次拨动转身。默认 10 ms，设为 0 则立即: The stick must stay below the tracking threshold before another flick can start. Defaults to 10 ms. Set to 0 to release immediately.
拨动选择朝向，沿摇杆外圈转动控制镜头。: Flick to choose a heading, then rotate the stick along its outer edge to turn the camera.
这些参数只调整连续瞄准，不改变拨动的目标转角或游戏本身的满杆转速。: These settings adjust continuous aiming. They do not change the Flick target angle or the game's full-stick turn speed.
这些规则由拨动／转动和配套摇杆瞄准共用。: These rules apply to both Flick Stick and companion stick aiming.
体感、拨动和配套摇杆瞄准共用这里的输出与转角换算。: Gyro, Flick and companion stick aiming share this output and turn calibration.
时间指数：0 为固定时间（默认），1 按转角等比例缩短，2 让小角度转身更快。上: Time exponent: 0 keeps a fixed duration (default), 1 scales it proportionally to the angle, and 2 makes small turns faster. The reference duration is for 180°. Only the initial turn is affected, not ongoing rotation.
用手柄的转动控制镜头。关闭后停止体感瞄准；拨动是否继续工作由它的独立启用设置决定: Use controller rotation to aim. Disabling gyro stops motion aim; Flick follows its independent enable setting.
按住时暂停体感瞄准，松开后恢复原来的启用状态。它不会同时关闭拨动。: Hold to pause gyro aim; release to restore its previous enable state. Flick is not paused by this input.
选择要由手腕改变方向的摇杆。它与拨动使用同一根摇杆时可能冲突。: Choose the stick whose heading is rotated by your wrist. Using the same stick as Flick can conflict.
体感接近水平或垂直方向时，把运动拉向对应轴。角度越大越容易走直线，但斜向微调也更: Pull gyro movement toward horizontal or vertical axes when nearby. Larger angles favor straight lines but can resist diagonal adjustments. This does not snap Flick angles.
选择用鼠标还是虚拟右摇杆控制镜头。体感、拨动和配套瞄准共用此选项；摇杆模式需要先: Choose mouse or virtual right-stick camera output. Gyro, Flick and companion aim share this setting. Stick output requires a virtual controller.
忽略中心附近的小幅输入。调大可减少漂移，但需要推得更远才有反应；拨动、摇杆鼠标和: Ignore small inputs near center. Larger deadzones reduce drift but require more travel. Flick, stick mouse and virtual-stick output share this processing.
推到这个幅度就算进入外圈，可用于内外圈按键映射。它不是拨动的触发距离。: Travel that enters the outer ring for ring-button mappings. This is separate from the Flick trigger distance.
用普通推杆持续移动鼠标。它与拨动的定角度转身不同；使用同一摇杆时还受拨动的原始输: Move the mouse continuously with stick travel, unlike Flick's angle-based turns. On the same stick, Flick's input suppression also applies.
选择进行拨动和配套摇杆瞄准的摇杆。两项功能共用这里的选择。: Choose the stick shared by Flick and companion stick aim.
推到这个幅度才触发初始拨动。调低更容易触发，调高更需要推向外圈。: Stick travel required to trigger the initial turn. Lower values trigger more easily; higher values require pushing toward the rim.
在拨动之外增加普通连续瞄准，让推杆幅度控制转速。可结合快速判定区分慢推瞄准和拨动: Add ordinary continuous aim alongside Flick, with stick travel controlling speed. Speed gating can distinguish slow aiming from quick flicks.
只放大配套连续瞄准的速度，不改变拨动的目标角度。: Scale companion continuous aim speed without changing the Flick target angle.
向正前方附近推杆时，不执行初始拨动，但仍可继续转动。角度越大，正前方不转身的范围: Skip the initial turn when pushing close to forward, while allowing subsequent rotation. Larger angles widen this forward zone.
启用快速判定后，慢推被认定为瞄准，就不再触发拨动，直到摇杆回中开始下一次操作。: With speed gating enabled, a slow push stays in aiming mode and cannot trigger Flick until the stick returns to center.
关闭体感总开关后，仍允许拨动和配套摇杆瞄准工作，适合只使用摇杆的配置。: Allow Flick and companion aim even when the main gyro switch is off, useful for stick-only profiles.
只在按住这个输入时允许拨动和配套瞄准。不设置则无需额外按键，但仍受各自启用开关控: Allow Flick and companion aim only while this input is held. Leave unset to require no extra button; their enable switches still apply.
决定拨动使用摇杆时，普通摇杆映射是否还能收到输入。屏蔽可避免同一动作重复推动镜头: Control whether ordinary mappings also receive the stick used by Flick. Suppression helps avoid driving the camera twice from one movement.
拨动的按住开启和按住暂停不能同时设置: Flick hold to enable and hold to pause cannot both be configured
按住时暂停拨动和配套摇杆瞄准，取消剩余转角并交还原始摇杆；松开后恢复。若暂停时摇: Hold to pause Flick and companion stick aim, cancel the remaining turn, and restore the original stick mapping. Release to resume. If the stick was at the rim while paused, return it to center before pushing again. This is independent of gyro pause and mutually exclusive with hold to enable.
JSM 线性：加速倍率 1×，关闭额外平滑、低速抑制、吸附与刹车。保留当前灵敏度: JSM linear: 1× acceleration with extra smoothing, low-speed suppression, snapping and braking disabled. Keeps sensitivity, coordinates, turn calibration and custom filters.
拨动摇杆时转到目标方向；保持在外圈并转动时不再转向。回中后可以再次拨动。配套摇杆: Flick to face the target direction; rotating around the outer ring adds no further turn. Recenter before flicking again. Companion stick aim is configured separately.
100% 对齐最近方向，0% 保留原始角度，中间值柔和偏向最近方向。只作用于初始: 100% snaps to the nearest direction; 0% keeps the original angle. Intermediate values bias toward the nearest direction. Only the initial flick is snapped; rotation stays continuous.
对应 JSM 的 FLICK_ONLY：保留初始拨动，关闭外圈转动。回到释放区域: Equivalent to JSM FLICK_ONLY: keeps the initial flick and disables outer-ring rotation. Return to the release region before flicking again. Companion stick aim is configured separately.
四向按 90°、八向按 45° 对齐初始拨动方向。吸附不作用于后续转动，也不改变: Aligns the initial flick to 90° or 45° intervals. Does not snap subsequent rotation or gyro direction.
100% 完全对齐最近方向，0% 保留原始角度。中间值按比例偏向最近方向。: 100% aligns fully with the nearest direction; 0% keeps the original angle. Intermediate values apply a proportional bias.
拨动角度吸附仅支持 NONE、4 或 8: Flick snapping supports only NONE, 4 or 8
当前只能把一个摇杆用于瞄准／拨动，请手动选择: Only one stick can currently be used for aim/flick; choose it manually
在拨动之外增加普通连续瞄准，让推杆幅度控制转速。可结合快速判定区分慢推瞄准和快推: Add ordinary continuous aim alongside Flick, with stick travel controlling speed. Speed gating can distinguish slow aiming from quick flicks.
拨动摇杆选择转身角度，保持在外圈转动可继续旋转镜头。需要先校准游戏转角。: Flick the stick to choose the turn angle; rotate around the outer ring to continue turning. Calibrate the in-game turn scale first.
切换到鼠标或虚拟右摇杆体感输出后，可使用拨动和配套摇杆瞄准。: Select mouse or virtual right-stick gyro output to use Flick and companion stick aiming.
请在「设置与组件」将虚拟手柄后端设为 ViGEm，再使用 DS4 传感器直通。: Set the virtual gamepad backend to ViGEm in Settings and components to use DS4 sensor passthrough.
DS4 传感器直通需要选择虚拟 DualShock 4 和 ViGEm 后端。: DS4 sensor passthrough requires a virtual DualShock 4 with the ViGEm backend.
切换虚拟手柄类型前，请先在使用 DS4 传感器直通的基础层或配置层改用其他体感输: Choose another gyro output in the base profile and any layers that use DS4 sensor passthrough before changing the virtual controller type.
向虚拟 DualShock 4 发送经设备校准的陀螺仪和加速度计数据。请在支持读: Send calibrated gyro and accelerometer data to the virtual DualShock 4. Configure gyro in a game or Steam Input that can read DS4 sensors.
下面的转角换算用于按键触发的定角转身。: The conversion settings below apply to button-triggered fixed-angle turns.
使用同时支持陀螺仪和加速度计的实体手柄。设备静止校准和安装方向可在「设备与输入」: Use a physical controller with a gyroscope and accelerometer. Adjust stationary calibration and mounting orientation in Devices and input.
鼠标和右摇杆模式由 Studio 计算瞄准。DS4 传感器直通把设备数据交给游戏: Studio computes aiming for mouse and right-stick output. In DS4 sensor passthrough mode the game or Steam Input handles sensor data.
虚拟 PS4 传感器直通需要 ViGEm 手柄输出后端: Virtual PS4 sensor passthrough requires the ViGEm gamepad backend
虚拟 PS4 传感器直通需要支持陀螺仪和加速度计的体感接口: Virtual PS4 sensor passthrough requires a controller interface with a gyroscope and accelerometer
传感器直通由游戏处理，无需校准游戏转角。: The game handles sensor passthrough and does not require Studio turn calibration.
传感器直通需要选择虚拟 DualShock 4: Sensor passthrough requires a virtual DualShock 4
按所选开启方式，将设备校准后的传感器数据发送给虚拟手柄。: Send calibrated sensor data to the virtual controller using the selected activation mode.
发送给虚拟 DS4 前可处理三轴角速度。加速度计数据沿用设备校准。: Optional processing for three-axis angular velocity before sending it to the virtual DS4. Acceleration uses the device calibration.
平滑值越大，角速度越平稳，快速转动的响应也会变慢。0 关闭平滑。: A longer smoothing time steadies angular velocity and slows the response to quick turns. Set it to 0 to disable smoothing.
按设备静止校准得到的噪声底抑制小幅波动。0 关闭噪声抑制。: Suppress small fluctuations using the noise floor measured during stationary device calibration. Set it to 0 to disable suppression.
直通应用原始角速度脚本: Apply raw gyroscope scripts to passthrough
在直通时应用下方已启用的 Rhai 脚本。: Apply the enabled Rhai scripts below during passthrough.
直通启用脚本后，原始角速度脚本按列表顺序执行。每个配置最多保存 4 个滤波器。: When enabled, passthrough runs raw gyroscope scripts in list order. Each profile can store up to four filters.
转速达到阈值后直接响应。窗口或阈值为 0 时关闭前置平滑。: Rotation at or above the threshold responds immediately. Set the window or threshold to 0 to turn off pre-smoothing.
JSM 使用导入的平滑窗口，Studio 平滑时间最多为 50 ms: JSM uses the imported smoothing window. The Studio engine supports up to 50 ms.
已保留 JSM 的阈值或衰减平滑方式: Preserved the JSM choice of threshold or decay smoothing.
JSM 使用导入的平滑阈值，设为 0 可关闭前置平滑: JSM uses the imported smoothing threshold. A threshold of 0 disables pre-smoothing.
已启用 One Euro，在 JSM 中可与前置平滑同时使用: One Euro is enabled and can run after JSM pre-smoothing.
选择角速度瞄准后可切换引擎。: Select angular-velocity aiming to switch engines.
体感和快速转向使用 JSM 的响应。切换引擎后应用修改，即可用同一套键位和游戏校: Gyro aim and Flick Stick use the JSM response. Apply your changes after switching engines to compare them with the same bindings and game calibration.
JSM 直接处理校准后的采样。切回 Studio 可继续使用已保存的自定义滤波和: JSM processes calibrated samples directly. Switch back to Studio to use your saved custom filters and edge turning.
JSM 的玩家和世界坐标都使用加速度计估计重力方向。: JSM uses the accelerometer to estimate gravity in both player and world space.
此配置保存了 Studio 自定义控制点，JSM 当前使用线性加速。: This profile has a custom Studio curve. JSM is using linear acceleration.
高于低速截止时，两者之间的角速度会逐步恢复到完整输出。: Set this above the low-speed cutoff to gradually restore full output between the two speeds.
启用后只响应初始拨动。回中后可再次拨动。: Only the initial flick turns the camera. Recenter the stick to flick again.
JSM 按游戏满杆角速度输出。以当前校准值转过 90° 约需 {0} ms。: JSM turns at the game's full-stick speed. At the current calibration, a 90° turn takes about {0} ms.
达到阈值触发拨动，低于阈值的 90% 后可以再次拨动。: Reach the threshold to flick. Drop below 90% of the threshold to rearm.
填入游戏忽略的中心范围。JSM 会将静止输出放在该边界，方便观察游戏是否开始转动: Enter the center range ignored by the game. At rest JSM places the stick on this boundary so you can see when the camera starts to move.
填入游戏的摇杆响应指数以补偿曲线。线性响应可用 0 或 1。: Enter the game's stick response exponent to compensate for its curve. Use 0 or 1 for a linear response.
右摇杆内外死区补偿之和必须小于 100%: The combined right stick deadzone compensation must be under 100%
参数已保存在 Studio 配置中，选择 JSM 原生瞄准引擎后生效: Saved to the Studio profile. Select Native JSM as the aiming engine to apply this parameter.
已填入虚拟手柄布局，瞄准用摇杆交给快速转向设置: Imported the virtual gamepad layout. The aiming stick is configured under Flick Stick.
拨动需要鼠标或已启用的虚拟右摇杆: Flick output requires a mouse or an enabled virtual right stick
体感和拨动需要使用同一个输出目标: Gyro and Flick must share an output destination
